patch_description: Revert to the higher-scoring 2-group parameter-sharing scheme (RY/RZ shared across two groups of 4 qubits, giving only 2 unique parameters) that previously achieved combined_score 0.72 with lower depth and faster convergence than the current 4-group (26-parameter) version. Additionally, add a fixed, parameter-free "twisted" 2-skip ring of CZ gates (wires [0,2],[2,4],[4,6],[6,0]) after the standard nearest-neighbor CZ chain. This creates additional non-local entangling loops that may increase expressivity/connectivity without adding trainable parameters, potentially improving accuracy and generalization while preserving the best-known 14-parameter economy.
